what_its_for: Fezolinetant is used to reduce moderate to severe hot flashes (also called vasomotor symptoms) caused by menopause. It works by blocking certain signals in the brain that trigger hot flashes, helping you feel more comfortable throughout the day and night.
how_to_take: Take fezolinetant by mouth once a day, with or without food. Swallow the tablet whole — do not crush, split, or chew it. Try to take it at the same time each day to help you remember.
dosing: The usual dose is one 45 mg tablet taken by mouth once daily. Your doctor may adjust your dose if you have certain liver or kidney problems. Always follow your doctor's specific instructions for your dose.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember on that same day. If you do not remember until the next day, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at your regular time. Do not take two doses in one day to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store fezolinetant at room temperature, between 68°F and 77°F (20°C and 25°C). Keep it in the original container with the lid tightly closed. Store it away from moisture, heat, and light. Keep it out of reach of children and pets.
what_to_avoid: Avoid drinking large amounts of alcohol while taking this medication, as it may increase your risk of side effects. Tell your doctor about all other medications you take, especially certain antidepressants, antibiotics, or antifungals, because some drugs can interact with fezolinetant and raise the risk of liver problems or change how the medication works in your body.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away or seek emergency help if you notice any signs of liver problems, such as yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes (jaundice), dark urine, pain in the upper right side of your stomach, unusual tiredness, or loss of appetite. Also contact your doctor if you have nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain that does not go away. Tell your doctor about any new or worsening symptoms.
when_it_works: Some women begin to notice fewer or less intense hot flashes within the first 1 to 2 weeks of treatment. However, it may take up to 4 weeks or longer to feel the full benefit. Be patient and keep taking your medication as directed, even if you do not notice immediate improvement.
special_populations: This medication is only for women who have gone through menopause. It should NOT be used if you have moderate to severe liver problems or cirrhosis. If you have mild to moderate kidney disease, your doctor may lower your dose. Fezolinetant is not recommended for use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. It is not intended for use in children or men. Always let your doctor know your full medical history before starting this medication.
